messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up 1 1 Cohort 1 for Adoptivity just accepted the preview invites. Need to align on 3 things: onboarding checklist, short feedback pulses, and an early renewal trigger.
Logan: Nice. Any immediate blockers from their side?
Evelyn (Adoptivity): Thanks team! One ask: can we shorten the setup steps. Our ops team said the webhook step is confusing.
Diego: Can you paste the exact step they'd trouble with? I can propose a copy tweak + screenshot.
Evelyn (Adoptivity): Step says: "Create webhook with secret X and point to /api/events" 1 ops expected a token flow. They tried to paste the UI secret into the wrong field.
Priya: OK noted. Diego, can you add an inline screenshot and change the wording to "Generate token, then paste into Adoptivity 'Integration key' field"?
Diego: On it. I'll update the enablement doc and the quickstart widget text.
OnboardBot: Doc update created: DOC-902 tagged enablement, owner: Diego.
Logan: Feedback pulses 00000 propose lightweight triggers: immediate post-setup (1 Q), day-7 check-in (2 Q), and optional in-product micro-NPS after day-30. Keep responses single-click where possible.
Priya: Agree. Let's make the post-setup: "Was setup clear? (Yes / No)" + optional short field for blockers. Day-7: "Which task got you the most value? (multiple choice)" + "Would a 20-min walkthrough help? (Yes/No)"
Evelyn (Adoptivity): Can we also capture a short "expected value" metric on day-7 (one number)? Product team wants to map adoption to renewal.
Logan: Sure. Add Q: "Estimate weekly tasks automated using Redwood (0-100)" (slider). We'll bucket later.
Priya: Diego 1 please add the survey flow to the playbook and wire the events to our feedback-export job.
Diego: Will do. Which format do they want for exports? CSV or a direct Slack digest?
Evelyn (Adoptivity): CSV is best for product analysis, but a weekly Slack digest to their PM would be great too.
OnboardBot: Export job scheduled: FEED-71 -> weekly CSV to adoptivity-product@adoptivity.com on Fridays.
Priya: Renewal trigger: they're on a 4-month preview. If metric "weekly_active_users" < 8 by week 6 OR average task automation < 12/week, we'll auto-schedule a health workshop.
Logan: I'll set an alert rule in the onboard dashboard and add a playbook action to contact their CS lead.
Evelyn (Adoptivity): Heads-up 1 we're aiming for 15 WAUs and will run internal enablement to hit that. We'll share the invite list by Monday.
Diego: Quick technical note 1 we need to ensure the quickstart code snippet has the correct base URL for their region. I'll add a region check in the snippet:\n\n```
const base = process.env.REDWOOD_BASE || 'https://api.redwood.ai';
// replace for eu customers
```

Priya: Nice. Also can we add a tiny in-app tooltip on the webhook step pointing to the docs? Should reduce confusion.
Logan: I can add a tooltip trigger and track "tooltip_shown" and "tooltip_clicked" events. Priya, want those included in the weekly CSV?
Priya: Yes please. That helps quantify friction.
OnboardBot: Ticket SUP-998 created for tooltip implementation, severity: low. Owner: Logan. ETA: 5 business days.
Evelyn (Adoptivity): Thanks everyone. One small ask 1 could the CSV include recent support ticket links so we can follow context?
Priya: We'll include ticket id + subject + last update link in the export.
Diego: Final note 1 for the day-30 micro-NPS let's keep phrasing neutral: "How likely are you to recommend Redwood Inference to a colleague? (0-10)". We'll keep comments optional.
Logan: Sounds good. I'll prototype the micro-survey tiles this afternoon.
Priya: Assigning follow-ups: Diego -> docs and quickstart update; Logan -> tooltip + events + micro-survey tile; Priya -> create health-watch alert and the workshop POA; OnboardBot -> schedule weekly exports.
OnboardBot: Follow-ups created: DOC-902, SUP-998, FEED-71, ALERT-44. Recurring reminder set for "Review cohort 1 health" every Monday 10:00 PST.
Evelyn (Adoptivity): Appreciate the clear plan. We'll send the invite list Monday and ping if anything else pops up.
Priya: Closing this thread. Reopen if blockers surface. Thanks all :rocket:
